concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept for the EXISTING Sobrita Flutter mobile app. The attached screenshot is the actual product reference and must ground this design. Preserve the application's recognizable warm pixel-art character, square navy borders, cream paper surface, dark navy text, teal primary button with a small navy pixel offset shadow, gold gift/deadline accents, and readable Korean pixel typography (SobraHangul/Pixelify style). Use the exact recognizable Dracula Michi cat and Frankenstein Poodle from the reference screenshot, preserving faces, fur, costumes, colors and shaded pixel art. Do not redesign the mascot art.
Target dimensions: mobile app viewport 390 x 844 logical pixels, portrait image at 780 x 1688 to match the reference aspect ratio. App content only, with no phone bezel, device body, notch, OS status bar, battery, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask or external presentation background. Maintain natural proportions, no stretched typography or characters.
Brief: redesign ONLY the Halloween gift claim screen so the user understands the costumes they can wear NOW. This is a proposed screen, not an implemented feature. Mock ownership example: the user owns only Michi and Poodle. ONLY these TWO owned characters appear in previews. Do not show Alpaca or any unowned character. All TWELVE costumes are still received together once for free and stored permanently; future-unlocked characters can use their stored costume. Do not imply the gift unlocks base characters. No purchases, prices, coins, lock grid, new menu pages, tabs advertising unrelated features, progress bars, account avatar or invented features.
Date anchor: today is 2026-10-27, gift claim deadline is 2026-11-03. Visible deadline uses November 3, never invented dates.
One focused gift bottom sheet with one clear primary action, a gift icon and close X in the header. Dim the existing app very lightly above the sheet, keeping just a narrow amount of context; minimize empty dark space. Keep all content readable and unclipped within 390x844. Use purposeful spacing, grouping and alignment first. Preserve the source product's squared border language; avoid excessive cards inside cards, excessive badges, glossy 3D or generic rounded SaaS styling. Body type around 14-16 logical px, title 24-26px, small supporting text at least 13px. No watermark. Do not include multiple screens or alternative concepts in this image.
Exact Korean content must be legible and spelled correctly:
Title: "할로윈 축제 선물"
Deadline: "11월 3일까지 무료로 받을 수 있어요"
Primary action: "내 캐릭터의 할로윈 의상 받기"
Permanent ownership: "한 번 받으면 이벤트가 끝나도 영구 소장해요."
Future ownership: "나중에 얻는 캐릭터의 의상도 함께 보관돼요."
Do not use the old primary button "코스튬 12종 무료로 받기" or the old label "12종 중 미리보기".
Direction name: 내 친구들 미리보기.
Stay closest to the source bottom-sheet structure, with a warm title/short introduction and a wide, uncluttered TWO-CHARACTER hero row. Show Dracula Michi and Frankenstein Poodle side by side at equal large size, both fully visible, on the bare cream surface. One label under each: "Michi · 드라큘라" and "Poodle · 프랑켄슈타인". The main section heading is "지금 입힐 수 있는 의상 2벌", and the short introduction is "내 친구들의 특별한 변신을 만나보세요."
Below the pair, show the permanent ownership sentence in one restrained pale gold notice, with the future-ownership sentence directly below as muted plain text. Include a smaller transparent policy line "전체 12종의 의상을 함께 보관해요." so the limited preview is not mistaken for limited receipt. Finish with the full-width teal primary action. The emphasis must be the two available costumes and a clear single claim action. No selectable controls around the character row, no third character.
concepts.visualReview: checked legible Korean CTA, two owned companions only, deadline November 3, all 12 costumes kept permanently, no clipped content
